files.title: File:Schwartz farm (Lane Co KS) smokehouse and barn from SE 1.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Alexander and Anna Schwartz farm, located at northwest corner of East Road 70 and Quantum Road, southeast of Dighton in rural Lane County, Kansas.  Smokehouse and barn, seen from the southeast.  There is some false perspective in the photo: the barn is about 150 feet north of the smokehouse, but compression due to the use of a long zoom makes it appear as though the two buildings are close together, and as though the smokehouse is almost as large as the barn.

files.title: File:Schwartz farm (Lane Co KS) from S 1.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Alexander and Anna Schwartz farm, located at northwest corner of East Road 70 and Quantum Road, southeast of Dighton in rural Lane County, Kansas.  View is from the south, from 70.  There is some false perspective in the photo: the barn is about 150 feet north of the house, but compression due to the use of a long zoom makes it appear as though the barn is just behind the house, and smaller than the house.
